title: hood. — .hood name service
description: Resolve .hood names on Robinhood Chain — forward/reverse, text records, availability & pricing.
summary: Resolve .hood names on Robinhood Chain — forward/reverse, text records, availability & pricing.
offersHint: Resolve .hood names on Robinhood Chain — forward/reverse, text records, availability & pricing. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.hood.ag/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: resolve_name
toolsPreview.description: Forward-resolve a .hood name to the address it points to. Returns null if unset.

toolsPreview.name: reverse_resolve
toolsPreview.description: Reverse-resolve an address to its primary .hood name. `verified` is true only when the name's forward record points back to the address.

toolsPreview.name: resolve_text
toolsPreview.description: Read a text record (e.g. "avatar", "url", "com.twitter") set on a .hood name.

toolsPreview.name: check_availability
toolsPreview.description: Check whether a .hood name is available to register, and its yearly price.

toolsPreview.name: name_info
toolsPreview.description: Full snapshot of a .hood name: resolved address, NFT owner, expiry, and availability.
